article.content: Kvaratskhelia to undergo surgery on right knee Dembélé and Marquinhos out for weeks Paris Saint-Germain’s Khvicha Kvaratskhelia ⁠will undergo surgery after rupturing the anterior cruciate ⁠ligament in ⁠his ​right knee in the Champions League win over ⁠Barcelona . Kvaratskhelia twisted ⁠the knee during PSG’s 4-2 ​victory on ‌Tuesday and was ‌helped off the pitch just ‌before the hour, with the Georgian unable to put any weight on his right leg.
